title: A constructible subset is retrocompact in a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a space where quasi-compact opens form a basis, every constructible subset is retrocompact (author lemma at source lines 2949-2959, label lemma-constructible-is-retrocompact). The proof (source lines 2961-2971) decomposes the subset into finitely many differences of retrocompact opens, reduces to a single piece and uses that the piece is closed inside a quasi-compact open (proof lines 2961-2970). The reduction to one piece is the content. H3.
